title: Summoning A Futa Demon (ORIGINAL)
description: Did you really think that I was an angel? You fool. It's almost too easy to manipulate you into this. A whisper here, a nudge there and the rest you did yourself, summoning me to the realm of the living. Now I can do whatever I want, to anyone I want. All because of you! But first, I think it would be a waste to leave you alone... At the very least I could make you my personal toy. A thing for me to do as I please.
author: Mistress Shibby
